label: Figure 29.2: The elements of the IHDI
alt: Tree diagram showing the Inequality-adjusted Human Development Index built bottom-up from three inequality-adjusted dimension indices: life expectancy, education, and income.
caption: The Inequality-adjusted Human Development Index (IHDI) discounts each of the HDI’s three dimension indices (life expectancy, years of schooling, and income/consumption) for the inequality in its distribution across the population, then combines the three inequality-adjusted indices into the overall IHDI.
